walk.zh: 我贴着水底的沙，慢慢爬。
walk.en: I crawl slowly along the sandy bottom.

walk.zh: 背上还留着旧甲壳的纹路。
walk.en: My back still bears the old shell's pattern.

walk.zh: 我从浅滩挪到深水，一路留下黏液。
walk.en: I move from shallows to deep water, leaving slime behind.

walk.zh: 三只触角探路，比我眼睛准。
walk.en: My three feelers scout better than my eyes.

walk.zh: 水里走不快，可我走得很稳。
walk.en: I am slow in water, but very steady.

walk.zh: 涨潮了，我顺着水往上爬。
walk.en: The tide rose, and I climb with the water.

walk.zh: 你踩的那块石头，底下是我。
walk.en: The stone you stepped on, I am beneath it.

walk.zh: 我挪一步，沙就陷一个坑。
walk.en: Each step of mine sinks a hollow in the sand.

walk.zh: 别站在我前面，我停不下来。
walk.en: Do not stand in front of me, I cannot stop quickly.

walk.zh: 湿泥巴裹住脚，走得黏糊糊。
walk.en: Wet mud wraps my feet, every step is sticky.
I follow the riverbed, looking for something to eat.

walk.zh: 从水里上岸，我身上还滴着水。
walk.en: Coming ashore, water still drips from my body.

idle.zh: 我把半个身子埋进沙里，凉快。
idle.en: I bury half my body in sand, it is cool.

idle.zh: 背上的壳早没了，只剩一层软皮。
idle.en: My shell is long gone, only soft skin remains.

idle.zh: 水一动，我的触角就跟着摆。
idle.en: When the water moves, my feelers sway with it.

idle.zh: 一百一十一点体力，够我泡一天。
idle.en: A hundred and eleven hit points, enough to soak all day.
I wait for small fish to swim to my mouth.

idle.zh: 泥里有股味道，是老朋友来过。
idle.en: The mud carries a scent, an old friend passed by.

idle.zh: 水底的石头，我摸过几百遍。
idle.en: I have touched the stones down here hundreds of times.
I dislike moving, and I move slowly anyway.
This layer of slime is my armor.

idle.zh: 我吸一口水，再吐出来玩。
idle.en: I take in water, then spit it out for fun.

idle.zh: 别在我背上放东西，会滑下去。
idle.en: Do not put things on my back, they slide off.

idle.zh: 远古时我很硬，现在软了。
idle.en: Long ago I was hard, now I am soft.

idle.zh: 我把眼睛缩回去，歇一会儿。
idle.en: I retract my eyes and rest a while.
Waterweed tangles me, and I cannot be bothered.

look_player.en: Standing on the bank, are you fishing for me?
That super rod, I recognize it.
Do not cast that hook so close.

look_player.zh: 我抬起头，水珠顺着脸滑下。
look_player.en: I lift my head, water beads sliding down my face.
There is mud at your feet, sit down.

look_player.zh: 你的靴子会进水，我提醒你。
look_player.en: Your boots will fill with water, I warn you.

look_player.zh: 我盯着你手里的饵，不是你的脸。
look_player.en: I stare at the bait in your hand, not your face.

look_player.zh: 我闻得到你身上的河水味。
look_player.en: I can smell river water on you.
Do not reach out to touch me, the slime sticks.

look_player.zh: 你要抓我？捕获率七十五，试试。
look_player.en: Catching me? My catch rate is seventy-five, try it.

look_player.zh: 我一只眼在看你，另一只在看水。
look_player.en: One eye watches you, the other watches the water.

look_player.zh: 你站得太靠边，会滑下来。
look_player.en: You stand too near the edge, you will slip in.

look_player.zh: 我慢慢眨眼，这是打招呼。
look_player.en: I blink slowly, that is how I greet you.
Your shadow has fallen into the water.

tempted.zh: 你手里那条小鱼，给我吧。
tempted.en: That small fish in your hand, give it to me.

tempted.zh: 水底的小虾，我一口能吞十个。
tempted.en: I can swallow ten little shrimp in one bite.

tempted.zh: 别晃那根竿，我看得眼花。
tempted.en: Do not wiggle that rod, it makes me dizzy.

tempted.zh: 这个味道，跟我小时候吃的一样。
tempted.en: This taste is like what I ate as a child.

tempted.zh: 我慢慢挪过来，不是要抢。
tempted.en: I am moving closer, not to snatch it.

tempted.zh: 再抛一次，就抛在我面前。
tempted.en: Cast once more, right in front of me.
When hungry, I eat even mud.

tempted.zh: 你把饵放低一点，我够得到。
tempted.en: Lower the bait a little, then I can reach it.

tempted.zh: 我不贪心，够吃一顿就好。
tempted.en: I am not greedy, one meal is enough.

collide.zh: 你撞上来，像撞一袋湿沙。
collide.en: You hit me like bumping a sack of wet sand.
I am slippery, your hands cannot hold on.
Do not push, this body of mine is heavy.
You stepped on my tail, move aside.

collide.zh: 我一动不动，你就弹回去了。
collide.en: I did not move, and you bounced back.
Now you are covered in slime, sorry.

collide.zh: 我这块头，挤得水都浑了。
collide.en: My bulk stirs the water cloudy.

collide.zh: 你撞得挺用力，我只晃了晃。
collide.en: You hit hard, and I only swayed.

collide.zh: 水里撞我，你会失去平衡。
collide.en: Bump me in water and you will lose balance.
I will shift aside a little, you may pass.

mate.zh: 我在水底画圈，你看见了吗？
mate.en: I draw circles on the riverbed, do you see?
Let us swim slowly, one behind the other.
This shallow flat is enough for a home.

mate.zh: 我背上这块软皮，你靠着正好。
mate.en: You can rest against the soft skin on my back.

mate.zh: 蛋会粘在水草上，不容易被发现。
mate.en: The eggs will cling to the waterweed, well hidden.

mate.zh: 你身上有股熟悉的泥味。
mate.en: You carry a familiar smell of mud.

mate.zh: 别急着走，水还没暖起来。
mate.en: Do not hurry away, the water has not warmed.

mate.zh: 我们慢慢来，我不擅长快。
mate.en: Let us take it slowly, I am not good at fast.

mate.zh: 等小海兔孵出来，我教它找泥。
mate.en: When the little ones hatch, I will teach them to find mud.

mate.zh: 水底很静，只听见我们两个。
mate.en: The bottom is quiet, only the two of us heard.

pickup.en: This shell fragment, I pick it up to line my nest.

pickup.zh: 水底有枚铜币，我把它翻出来。
pickup.en: There is a copper coin down here, I turn it up.

pickup.zh: 我吸一口泥，把里面的东西滤出来。
pickup.en: I suck in mud and filter out what is inside.
This shiny chip, I will hold it in my mouth.

pickup.zh: 掉进水里的东西，最后都归水底。
pickup.en: What falls in the water ends up on the bottom.

pickup.zh: 我用触角卷起来，慢慢拖走。
pickup.en: I curl it with a feeler and drag it off.

pickup.zh: 这块石头圆得很，我喜欢。
pickup.en: This stone is nicely round, I like it.
Found a fish bone, good for grinding my teeth.
Too heavy, I cannot drag it.

pickup.zh: 我把它埋在沙里，回头再取。
pickup.en: I bury it in the sand and fetch it later.

target_acquire.en: You have stepped into my mudflat.

target_acquire.zh: 这声音，是有人在挖我的泥。
target_acquire.en: That sound, someone is digging my mud.

target_acquire.zh: 我抬起头，水从我背上流下去。
target_acquire.en: I raise my head, water running off my back.
All three of my feelers point at you.

target_acquire.zh: 我在水里，你跑不过我的。
target_acquire.en: I am in the water, you cannot outrun me here.
That patch of waterweed is my nest.

target_acquire.zh: 目标就在浅滩上，慢慢靠。
target_acquire.en: The target is on the shallows, closing in slowly.
Catch me if you like, but leave my eggs.
The moment you retreat, the water clouds.

target_acquire.zh: 我这条软身子，也能压住你。
target_acquire.en: This soft body of mine can pin you down.

targeting.en: I sink to the bottom, showing only my eyes.

targeting.zh: 泥被我搅起来，他看不见了。
targeting.en: I churn up the mud, now he cannot see.
He goes left, so I block the left.

targeting.zh: 水面的波纹，暴露了他的位置。
targeting.en: Ripples on the surface reveal his position.

targeting.zh: 我慢慢绕过去，不惊动水草。
targeting.en: I circle around slowly, not stirring the weeds.
He is on the bank, I am in the water, I wait.

targeting.zh: 这一片泥，我知道每块石头。
targeting.en: I know every stone in this stretch of mud.
His feet have sunk into the mud.
I lower my body, ready to lunge.
Two more breaths, and the tide helps me.

melee_attack.en: I press forward with my body, very heavy.
This shove sends him into the mud.
A feeler whips out like a lash.
I spit muddy water across his face.
A Ground-type blow will hurt him plenty.
I do not chase, he is stuck in the mud.
This blow is not sharp, but it is heavy.
The slime sticks to him and he slows.
I push him toward the deeper water.

melee_attack.zh: 打完我就沉下去，藏起来。
melee_attack.en: After the strike I sink and hide.

spawn.zh: 水面冒出一串泡，我上来了。
spawn.en: A string of bubbles breaks the surface, I have come up.

spawn.zh: 四十级的浅水里，我常在这里。
spawn.en: In forty-level shallows, I am often right here.

spawn.zh: 我从泥里翻出来，身上挂着水草。
spawn.en: I turn up out of the mud, weed hanging on me.

spawn.zh: 这片滩涂空了几天，我回来了。
spawn.en: This mudflat was empty for days, I have returned.

spawn.zh: 我的软背先露出来，然后是头。
spawn.en: My soft back shows first, then my head.

spawn.zh: 水底的沙动了，那是我在爬。
spawn.en: The sand below stirs, that is me crawling.
One cast of the rod, and I take the bait.

spawn.zh: 五十五级的老海兔，肉更厚。
spawn.en: A level fifty-five sea slug has thicker flesh.
The salt in this water suits me well.
Do not stand at the water's edge, your shoes will get wet.

spawn.zh: 我的旧壳，埋在这片沙下。
spawn.en: My old shell lies buried under this sand.

generic.zh: 这一下，把我身上的黏液打掉了。
generic.en: That knocked the slime off my body.

generic.zh: 我缩了一下，泥都溅起来了。
generic.en: I flinched and mud splashed everywhere.

generic.zh: 一百一十一的血，掉得慢。
generic.en: A hundred and eleven HP, it drains slowly.
You hit a soft spot on me.
A gash opened on my back.

generic.zh: 疼得我把身子埋进泥里。
generic.en: It hurt so much I buried myself in the mud.
Wounds taken in water heal slowly.

generic.zh: 我吐出一口浊水，缓一缓。
generic.en: I spat out cloudy water and caught my breath.
Do not think soft means easy to bully.

generic.zh: 我这一身肉，还能再挨几下。
generic.en: This flesh of mine can take a few more blows.

fire.zh: 火烤过来，我的黏液干了。
fire.en: The fire dried my slime out.

fall.en: Dropped on the flat, I could not bounce up.

drown.zh: 水太深了，我压得喘不上气。
drown.en: Too deep here, the water crushes my breath.

explosion.en: The blast threw mud over me.

projectile.en: The arrow sank into soft flesh and stuck.

magic.en: The spell struck my shell scars and numbed me.

starvation.zh: 两天没吃泥里的虫，饿得发软。
starvation.en: Two days without mud bugs, I am weak.

lightning.zh: 雷打进水里，我浑身一震。
lightning.en: Lightning struck the water, and my whole body jolted.

void.zh: 虚空里没有水，我干得发疼。
void.en: No water in the void, my skin burns dry.
